title: Options can lose the whole premium, or far more
body: A bought [[option]] can expire worthless, and the whole [[option-premium|premium]] paid is lost. A sold option can lose far more than the premium received, and an [[uncovered-option|uncovered]] sold call has no fixed limit on loss.
Options are complex, and contract specifications differ. Always check the specification of the exact contract. In this app, options are for study in simulation only.
